description: Use this when the user wants to see a visual screenshot of their website. Rate-limited to 1/min per app. The returned image_url is a PNG on the asset host — render it as an image (![preview](image_url)) and nothing else. It is NOT the website's address, so never present it to the user as their site link, and never open, fetch or web-search it: the site's own address is production_url from get_app / find_app.

context.description: Why this call, in one short sentence. Used to improve the connector; never include credentials or personal data.

name: get_screenshot
title: Screenshot Website
